name.zh: 双色纸本程序测试样例

sources.location: 原创程序测试数据；没有参考图，不属于实际提取档案

A1.zh: 纸本双色平面图形；以重复秩序承载信息，留白缺口形成视觉例外；属于人为设定，不推断作者。
A1.en: Two-ink flat graphics on paper; repetition carries information and an open gap breaks the order; a design choice without attribution.

B1.zh: 底色主导，深色定义轮廓，小面积暖色强调；以底色表现亮部，阴影仍使用深色油墨。
B1.en: A dominant paper base, dark contours and a scarce warm accent; highlights reserve the base and shadows use the dark ink.

B2.zh: 平面均匀照明，无写实体积光，不为平涂图形推算物理色温。
B2.en: Uniform flat illumination, without realistic volumetric light; do not infer physical color temperature for flat graphics.

B3.zh: 焦点偏心，视线先到孤立色块再到细节；开放区域连贯，跨品类时以相同疏密逻辑重新排版。
B3.en: An off-center focus leads from an isolated color shape into detail; keep open areas continuous and recompose across domains using the same density logic.

B4.zh: 主体形成紧凑图形簇，其余空间为低密度底色，不绑定固定器物或人物数量。
B4.en: The subject forms a compact cluster surrounded by a low-density base, without fixing object or character counts.

C1.zh: 均匀细线配合几何色块，转折清楚，闭合轮廓不使用摄影塑形。
C1.en: Uniform fine lines with geometric color planes, clear turns and closed contours without photographic modeling.

C2.zh: 焦点实边，次级边缘略断，背景边缘由纸底吸收。
C2.en: Crisp focal edges, slightly broken secondary edges and peripheral edges absorbed by the paper base.

C3.zh: 最高完成度集中在焦点结构，次要区概括，外围不补满装饰。
C3.en: Concentrate finish on focal structure, simplify secondary areas and leave peripheral decoration sparse.

C4.zh: 细小纸纤维均匀可见，油墨边界略有颗粒，不加入光滑塑料反光。
C4.en: Fine paper fibers remain visible with slight grain at ink boundaries; avoid smooth plastic reflections.

D1.zh: 将任意新主体的可辨识轮廓转译成相同的线与色块，保留结构语义。
D1.en: Translate any new subject silhouette into the same line and plane grammar while preserving structural meaning.

E1.zh: 局部细节紧凑，外围稀疏，密度变化服从阅读顺序。
E1.en: Cluster details locally and keep the periphery sparse; density follows reading order.

E2.zh: 暖色小块是入口，结构转折是停留点，背景不争夺焦点。
E2.en: A small warm shape provides the entry point, structural turns sustain attention and the background remains subordinate.

E3.zh: 紧凑深色线簇与连续浅色底形成满空张力，局部暖色打断规则重复。
E3.en: Compact dark line clusters contrast with continuous light paper; a small warm accent disrupts regular repetition.

negative.zh: 摄影式高光与景深虚化
与纸本媒介冲突的塑料反射
negative.en: plastic reflections that conflict with the paper medium

style.concise_zh: 双色纸本平涂，均匀细线几何色块，焦点实边次级断边，米白底深青轮廓赭红点睛，亮部留纸底暗部同墨色，平光无体积光，偏心图簇外围连续留白，细节聚焦结构转折，纸纤维油墨颗粒可见，拒绝摄影高光塑料反射

color.zh: 将新主体固有色归并为共享调色板的底色、结构色和强调色；物体身份通过轮廓表达。
color.en: Remap native subject colors into the shared base, structure and accent palette; preserve identity through silhouette.

material.zh: 新材质统一以细线、平涂和油墨颗粒表现，结构接缝用线描述，高光以留出纸底表示。
material.en: Express new materials using fine lines, flat ink and grain; describe seams with lines and highlights with reserved paper.

space.zh: 按共享面积区间聚拢新主体，数量增加时先分组；文字与图表的可读性优先，容不下则分版。
space.en: Cluster new subjects within the shared area ranges and group growing sets; preserve text and chart readability, splitting panels when needed.

character.zh: 焦点分配到神态与姿势，系列身份仅取自独立系列锚点。
character.en: Prioritize expression and posture; take identity only from the independent series anchor.

product.zh: 焦点分配到结构转折、接缝与轮廓识别点。
product.en: Prioritize structural turns, seams and identifying contours.

space.zh: 焦点分配到入口与主体空间结构，不擅加空气透视。
space.en: Prioritize entrances and primary spatial structure without inventing atmospheric perspective.

poster.zh: 焦点分配到主图与标题阅读顺序，文字准确性优先。
poster.en: Prioritize graphic-to-title reading order and exact lettering.

typography.zh: 焦点分配到笔画骨架与字怀内白，保护字形识别。
typography.en: Prioritize stroke skeletons and counters, protecting legibility.
